message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go |
|------|------------|-------------|
| **1** | Identify the source and time of the disturbance. | Gather details (address, dates, times, description). |
| **2** | Contact the City of Atlanta’s **Department of Public Safety – Noise Control**. | Phone: (404) 656‑2000 (or toll‑free 1‑800‑555‑1234). |
| **3** | File a formal complaint online. | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website at <https://www.atlantaga.gov> → “Services” → “Noise Complaint.” |
| **4** | Follow up if needed. | If the issue persists, you may request a follow‑up inspection or escalation to the City Council’s Committee on Public Safety. |

*Tip:* Keep a record of all communications and any evidence (e.g., audio recordings, photos) to support your complaint.
